title: 第11章 一手攥碎人形天雷一脚跺灭无边雷海第12章 圣地老祖醒来拜见陈长生
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
原本覆盖天穹的是雷云。
如今则变成了无边的雷海！
无边雷海涌动，场景骇然至极，真真若灭世景象般！
九头狮哪还敢留在原地，拼了命的逃窜。
什么所谓的优雅，全被它抛到了脑后。
接下来的天劫，注定要比先前更加恐怖可怕！
“我…去！”
“快跑！”
一众长老顾不得嘲笑九头狮，同疯狂逃窜。
轰隆——
雷海爆发出恐怖轰鸣声，更加恐怖的天劫降临！
那是什么？！
竟有一道人形天雷从雷海中轰杀出来！
人形天雷！
一众长老逃亡的时候，见到这道人形天雷。
全都没被活活吓死！
这是古史中记载的最恐怖天劫！
降下人形天雷，说明天道怒到了极点。
天道不再留活路，断绝了所有能活下来的希望！
人形天雷又被称之为死亡天劫。

但凡降下人形天雷。
无一例外。
全都活不了，皆会被人形天雷轰杀掉。
遥远的乱古时代。
有位至高天帝，功参造化，修为境界深不可测。
他断层碾压整个乱古时代！
在他所在的时代，没有任何强者能挡住他一击。
传闻他极有可能自天帝境中超脱了出去。
踏上了比天帝境更高的境界。
天帝在他面前不堪一击，弱的不成样子。
然而。
不知为何，他被降下天劫。
天劫中出现人形天雷！
人形天雷只是一击而已，就将他从世间彻底抹杀掉！
还有。
太古年间。
一头无敌凶兽，疑似也自天帝境中超脱了出去。
拥有断层碾压天帝的超恐怖实力！
它更为的凶残，以天帝为血食。
在它所在的太古时代，诸多天帝被它当成血食给吃掉了。

后来，不知为何。
content_en:
What originally covered the sky were thunderclouds.
Now it has become a boundless sea of ​​thunder!
The boundless sea of ​​thunder surged, and the scene was extremely horrifying, truly like a scene of world destruction!
The nine-headed lion didn't dare to stay where it was and ran away with all its might.
All so-called elegance is thrown away by it.
The next catastrophe is destined to be even more terrifying than the previous one!
"I...go!"
"Run!"
The elders didn't care to laugh at the nine-headed lion, and they all ran away like crazy.
Boom——
The sea of thunder erupted with terrifying roars, and an even more terrifying disaster came!
What is that? !
There was actually a humanoid sky thunder blasting out from the sea of ​​thunder!
Humanoid thunder!
When a group of elders were fleeing, they saw this humanoid sky thunder.
None of them were scared to death!
This is the most terrifying disaster recorded in ancient history!
The human-shaped thunder falling down shows that Heaven is extremely angry.
Heaven no longer leaves any way to survive, and has cut off all hope of survival!
The humanoid sky thunder is also called the catastrophe of death.
Whenever humanoid thunder falls.
Without exception.
None of them will survive, they will all be killed by the humanoid sky thunder.
Distant ancient times.
There is a supreme heavenly emperor, whose merits are closely related to creation and whose realm of cultivation is unfathomable.
His fault crushed the entire ancient era!
In his time, no strong man could block his blow.
Rumor has it that he most likely transcended from the Heavenly Emperor realm.
Set foot on a higher realm than the Heavenly Emperor realm.
The Emperor of Heaven was vulnerable in front of him, extremely weak.
However.
For some reason, he was subjected to a catastrophe.
Humanoid thunder appears in the catastrophe!
The humanoid sky thunder just struck him and completely wiped him out of the world!
besides.
Ancient times.
An invincible beast seemed to have escaped from the realm of the Emperor of Heaven.
Possessing the super terrifying power of crushing the Emperor of Heaven with faults!
It is even more ferocious and feeds on the Emperor of Heaven.
In the ancient times where it existed, many emperors of heaven were eaten by it as blood food.
Later, I don’t know why.
